info.name: ePlatform-App - Auth Refresh & Logout Flow
info.description: End-to-end tests for Auth refresh-token rotation, logout, Gateway instances, Product Catalog, Inventory stock and reservations, authenticated Shopping Cart and Order workflows, and order notifications. Set email and password in a local Postman environment.

item.name: 02 - Refresh Token A (rotate to Token B)

exec: pm.test('First refresh returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Rotation returns a new refresh token', function () {
pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty;
pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.not.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('tokenA'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('tokenB', body.refreshToken);

item.name: 03 - Reuse old Token A (must revoke family)

exec: pm.test('Reusing rotated Token A returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: 04 - Use Token B after reuse (must be revoked)

exec: pm.test('Token B is rejected after family revocation', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Second login returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();
pm.test('Login returns refresh token for logout', function () { pm.expect(body.refreshToken).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.collectionVariables.set('logoutToken', body.refreshToken);
pm.test('Logout returns 204 No Content', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test('Refresh after logout returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });

item.name: Gateway Instance Verification

exec:
pm.test('Gateway 1 health returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Gateway 1 status is UP', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'); });

pm.test('Gateway 2 health returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Gateway 2 status is UP', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP'); });

pm.test('Gateway 2 accepts token issued through Gateway 1', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Current-user response is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('object'); });

item.description: Verify both API Gateway instances are healthy and that an access token issued through Gateway 1 (8090) is accepted by Gateway 2 (8091).

item.name: Inventory
item.description: Run in order. Creates an isolated product ID, adds stock, tests reservations, idempotent retries, insufficient-stock rejection, commit, release, and final counts. Requires a valid local account and both Gateway and Inventory Service running.

exec:
pm.test('Inventory Service health returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('UP');

pm.collectionVariables.set('inventoryProductId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('inventoryAdjustmentId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('inventoryReservationId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));

pm.test('Repeating the same reservation is idempotent', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.reservationId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('inventoryReservationId'));
pm.collectionVariables.set('inventoryFailedReservationId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));
pm.test('Reservation exceeding available stock returns 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('inventoryReleaseReservationId', pm.variables.replaceIn('{{$guid}}'));

pm.test('Second reservation returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('ACTIVE');

item.name: 04 - Clear existing cart before order test

exec:
pm.test('Placed order is cancelled', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.status).to.eql('CANCELLED');

pm.test('Oversized cart quantity is accepted before checkout', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items[0].quantity).to.eql(11);

pm.test('Checkout rejects unavailable stock', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('stock');
pm.test('Rejected checkout retry remains rejected', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });

exec:
pm.test('Failed checkout cart is cleared for cleanup', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.items).to.have.length(0);
